content.introduction: The Economic Calendar on Investing.com tracks high-impact financial events and economic indicators, including central bank interest rate decisions, Non-Farm Payrolls (NFP), GDP releases, the Consumer Price Index (CPI), and unemployment data, which are marked with three stars due to their potential to cause significant market volatility. The Google Play app "Economic Calendar: Market News" offers real-time data, AI-driven insights, and historical market context to help users stay informed about global economic developments. Tradingeconomics.com's Economic Calendar provides a table with actual values, consensus figures, forecasts, statistics, and historical data charts for economic indicators from 196 countries.
body:
The Economic Calendar is a real-time, streaming schedule of economic events and data releases that can move financial markets. It tracks indicators such as GDP, inflation, employment figures, interest rate decisions, manufacturing PMI, consumer confidence, and central bank speeches from countries around the world.

# Economic Calendar

Our real-time Economic Calendar keeps track of all financial events and economic indicators that drive the markets. The Economic Calendar contains a full descriptions of the events and their relative importance in affecting the market, in addition to previous, forecast and actual figures as they're announced.

 Expiration [...] The highest-impact events include central bank interest rate decisions, Non-Farm Payrolls (NFP), GDP releases, the Consumer Price Index (CPI), and unemployment data. These are typically marked with three stars on the calendar because they can cause significant volatility across forex, equities, commodities, and bond markets. Filtering by high importance is a quick way to focus on the releases most likely to move prices.

### How can I filter and customize the Economic Calendar?

Stay informed, stay ahead. Economic Calendar is the ultimate AI-powered financial news companion for anyone who follows global markets closely.  
Don't just track the dates — understand the impact. Unlike traditional economic calendars that offer static event lists, Economic Calendar provides real-time data, AI-driven insights, and historical market context to help you stay informed about global economic developments instantly.  
  
AI-POWERED ECONOMIC INTELLIGENCE [...] Economic Calendar is built for finance professionals and enthusiasts who follow global economic events, investors interested in understanding macroeconomic trends, students and analysts studying central bank decisions and economic indicators, and anyone who wants to stay informed about global financial developments.  
Stay ahead of the curve. Download Economic Calendar today and never miss an important economic event again.
